improvements_submitted.description: Merged main into develop: restores dotnet.yml CI workflow and several previously-merged library features (arithmetic/TimeSpan/DateTimeOffset interop, IFormattable/IParsable/ISpanParsable, Unix epoch helpers, GeneratedRegex perf, protobuf-net.Core 3.2.56, 411 lines of tests) that existed only on main. Build + 87/87 tests passed on net8/9/10. Blocked as a real PR by protected-files policy -> landed as issue #37 with a manual-create-PR link; still open, awaiting maintainer action.

DateTimeNano.ToString() implemented ISpanFormattable.TryFormat to avoid two intermediate string allocations previously caused by interpolation ($"{DateTime:...}.{frac:D9}"). ToString() now backed by string.Create+TryFormat. Custom format strings still fall back to DateTime-precision formatting exactly as before. Added 3 new tests (TryFormat default/custom format, too-small destination). Build succeeded, 90/90 tests passed net8/9/10. Created as draft PR via safeoutputs create_pull_request (Task 8 - Performance Improvements).
